title: Lubrication — Scheduled Interval Due
description: Lubrication cycle interval counter has reached {val} hours since last full service. Lube point inspection recommended.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect all lube points for oil film
remedy: Perform lubrication inspection per maintenance checklist MAINT-LUB-001.
required_action: Log event. No immediate action required. Review at end of shift.
escalation_path: If LUB-WN-001 is not addressed (log event. no immediate action required. review at end of shift.), the fault will escalate in this order: LUB-SR-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
